description: A UK user's weather question of 2026-10-23 on Qwen3.5-4B (web search on): the results (Exa's weather pages) gave the temperatures in °F, titles like "<Town>, Scotland, United Kingdom Weather Today, Oct 23 | 35°F, Overcast", and the answer copied them: "temperatures around 35°F (1.5°C), feeling colder at 30°F… Winds are light at about 2–4 mph".
